artifact_selectors.selector: all rows with external == false; start/end are inclusive
artifact_selectors.meaning: Actual flow-body intervals in the saved Ghidra Program; source semantics unestablished

Observed instructions independently checked against selected target bytes

artifact_selectors.selector: all rows grouped by location and category

sqlite_selectors.selector: SELECT * FROM extents ORDER BY ordinal
sqlite_selectors.question: All declared ranges are linearly decoded; recover actual body boundaries, role and AS dependency/source ownership.

sqlite_selectors.selector: SELECT * FROM extents WHERE decoded_end < end ORDER BY ordinal
sqlite_selectors.question: Any undecoded suffix needs exact range recovery; an empty set does not establish reachable-code completeness.

sqlite_selectors.selector: SELECT * FROM regions ORDER BY start
sqlite_selectors.question: Classify every complement range and its non-padding/leaf/inline/data role; preserve candidate padding as unknown.

sqlite_selectors.selector: SELECT * FROM refs WHERE kind IN ('call_indirect','jump_indirect') ORDER BY site,kind,operand

sqlite_selectors.selector: SELECT * FROM refs WHERE kind NOT IN ('call_indirect','jump_indirect') ORDER BY site,kind,operand
